checks.name: Baseline Immutability
checks.rule: Methodology V1 and Dataset V1 strictly frozen

checks.name: Controlled Evolution
checks.rule: 4-Layer Governance separates baseline from extensions

checks.name: No Methodology Prison
checks.rule: Intake pipeline registers and classifies all new criteria

checks.name: Intake Classification
checks.rule: 6-Type categorization (Types A-F) strictly enforced

checks.name: Backward Compatibility
checks.rule: Compatibility status (Compatible, Experimental, etc.) assigned

checks.name: Schema Version Lineage
checks.rule: Additive field versioning preserves historical schemas

checks.name: Taxonomy Evolution
checks.rule: New domains added without retroactively modifying V1

checks.name: Temporal State Invariance
checks.rule: valid_from/valid_to enforced on all new relationships

checks.name: Preservation of UNKNOWN
checks.rule: UNKNOWN / NO_EVIDENCE stratum strictly preserved

checks.name: Hypothesis Invalidation
checks.rule: Scientific failure recorded as valid output (not data rejection)

checks.name: Conclusion Mutability
checks.rule: V2 allowed to find stronger, weaker, or zero effects

checks.name: Research Branching
checks.rule: Sandboxed branches prevent mutating parent baselines

checks.name: 10-Point Promotion Gate
checks.rule: Promotion requires meeting all 10 institutional criteria

checks.name: Point-In-Time Integrity
checks.rule: publication_time <= AS_OF enforced on all new sources

checks.name: Source Provenance
checks.rule: Cryptographic SHA-256 hashes recorded for all new files

checks.name: Strategy Isolation
checks.rule: Type F strategy changes quarantined from historical foundation

checks.name: Methodology Versioning
checks.rule: Type E changes mandate distinct METHODOLOGY_V2 version

checks.name: Entity Resolution Bounds
checks.rule: Ambiguous entities mapped to ENTITY_UNRESOLVED

checks.name: Replication-First Mandate
checks.rule: Dataset V2 must replicate V1 subset before expansion

checks.name: Causal Overclaim Prevention
checks.rule: New evidence classified under strict 6-level causality hierarchy
